selection_rule: All entries are predeclared. Architecture changes require a new registry version before any V2 outer-fold result is inspected.
promotion_rule: A model above 25K parameters advances only when paired bootstrap confidence intervals show a benefit in both balanced accuracy and AUROC, event sensitivity does not regress at FAR <= 0.5/h, and the model is Pareto-nondominated for parameters, MACs, peak activation memory, and INT16 degradation.

candidates.implementation: v2_bandpower_linear; log power in 0.5-4,4-8,8-13,13-30,30-45 Hz bands then linear classifier
v2_vanilla_1dcnn; ordinary Conv-BN-ReLU-AvgPool blocks with channels 16,24,32 and kernels 7,5,3
v2_deep_matched_1dcnn; ordinary Conv-BN-ReLU-AvgPool blocks with channels 12,16,20,24 and kernels 7,5,5,3
parallel_multikernel_1dcnn; parallel full-convolution branches with kernels 15 and 31
dilated_hierarchical_separable_1dcnn; default causal 31/7/3 hierarchy with dilations 4 and 8
paper_a_multiscale_residual_1dcnn; multiscale residual dilated CNN, not a claimed exact EEGWaveNet reproduction
